mapper.sql: from material_extraction me join paper p on p.paper_id = me.paper_id and p.deleted = false
mapper.select:
select as material_key, min(me.material) as material, count(distinct me.paper_id) as paper_count, count(*) as occurrence_count, max(me.confidence) as max_confidence
group by order by material_key asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select as material_key, me.material as material, me.property as property, me.method as method, me.confidence as confidence, cast(me.detail_json as varchar) as detail_json, p.paper_id as paper_id, p.title as title, p.authors as authors, p.year_published as year_published, p.doi as doi, p.status as state, p.citation_count as citation_count, p.update_time as updated_at
order by p.update_time desc, p.create_time desc, p.paper_id desc, me.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(distinct ) as total_materials, count(distinct me.paper_id) as total_papers, count(*) as total_occurrences, coalesce(avg(me.confidence), 0) as avg_confidence from material_extraction me join paper p on p.paper_id = me.paper_id and p.deleted = false

SELECT * FROM material_extraction WHERE detail_json IS NOT NULL AND detail_json::text != '' AND detail_json::text != 'null' AND detail_json::text != '{}' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
